newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S GIANT SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S GIANT SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: Profile of the winner of Sunday's men's World Cup Alpine skiing giant slalom:
Previous World Cup victories: (Seven) Veysonnaz 1993, Val d'Isere 1994, Tignes 1995, Vail 1995, Park City 1995, Adelboden 1996, Hinterstoder 1996.

Other facts: World Cup giant slalom champion, bronze medallist in slalom at 1996 world championships. Married with one child. A quiet, shy man who was brought up by his sister after his parents died when he was young.
